whatItDoes: Add a 0.75% sales tax in West Metro Fire Protection District, equal to 75 cents on a $100 taxable purchase. Groceries, gas and medicine would be exempt. The tax would raise up to $36.3 million in fiscal year 2027 and whatever amounts it produces later. Money would support fire and emergency medical response, staffing, responder health and safety, medical and rescue equipment, and wildfire response. It would be added to other district taxes. A citizen board would review district revenue monthly, an independent audit would review it annually, and reports would appear online. Sales-tax revenue and investment earnings could be kept and spent outside Colorado’s constitutional revenue and spending limits and other legal limits.
yesMeans: Approve the additional sales tax for district emergency services, spending reviews and the revenue-limit exception.
noMeans: Do not approve this sales tax or its proposed revenue-limit exception.

whatItDoes: Increase Conifer Fire Protection District’s property-tax rate by 4 mills beginning January 1, 2027, to raise $400,000 in the first full fiscal year or the amount the levy produces. Money would support emergency services, staffing, facilities, vehicles and equipment. The resulting total 16-mill levy could be adjusted annually to offset revenue lost through refunds and tax abatements. The district could keep and spend the levy’s proceeds and other revenue from any year outside Colorado’s constitutional revenue limits and other legal limits, with a permanent waiver of the 5.5% statutory property-tax limit.
yesMeans: Approve the additional property-tax levy, annual adjustments for refunds and abatements, and permanent revenue-limit exceptions.
noMeans: Do not approve this property-tax increase, levy adjustments or the proposed permanent revenue-limit exceptions.

whatItDoes: Increase the limit for the 17th Judicial District’s elected district attorney from two to three consecutive terms. The district includes Adams County and Broomfield, which elect one district attorney together.
yesMeans: Increase the district attorney’s limit from two to three consecutive terms.
noMeans: Keep the current limit of two consecutive terms.
